composition: Contra Dam arch in the Verzasca gorge · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Contra Dam is the thin concrete arch, about 220 metres high, that closes the Verzasca gorge in Tenero-Contra and holds Lago di Vogorno. The view is the dam from below, with no one on the crest. This replaces Piazza Grande, already published. The Open-Meteo model is clear and mild, about 18°C, with no cloud, a breeze, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
